title: Small talk
shortDescription: Practice easy, everyday small talk — weather, weekend plans, and more.
communicativeGoals: Make and respond to light conversational openers
Ask follow-up questions to keep a casual chat going
grammarTargets: Going to / will for weekend plans
conversationMoves: Cover light topics like weekend plans, weather, or how their week is going
Follow up naturally on whatever they share
Keep the tone casual and friendly, like waiting in line or before a meeting
warmUpPrompts: How's your week going so far?
rolePlayPrompts: Make small talk while waiting for a meeting to start.
Catch up with someone you haven't spoken to in a while.
challengePrompts: Keep a conversation going for several turns using only follow-up questions.
Politely wrap up a conversation because you need to leave.
successCriteria: Learner asks at least two follow-up questions
Learner shares something about themselves, not just answers

suggestedReviewItems.content: 'How's it going?' as a casual opener
Going to / will for talking about plans

focusPlaceholder: e.g. a specific setting (office, waiting room, party)
